    Translation invariance of Gabriel push-down #

    The push-down of a translated module is canonically isomorphic to the push-down of the original module. For a possibly noncommutative additive group, the b-summand of the translated push-down is reindexed as the (b-a)-summand of the original push-down. Shift associativity proves that this right reindexing commutes with the left degree translation used by orbit morphisms.
